title: Microstructure, mechanical properties and tribological behavior of the low-pressure cold sprayed tin bronze-alumina coating in artificial seawater
InformationInFigures: Yes. PSD (Fig. 1), Hardness for CS20A (Fig. 9), Porosity and Al2O3 in deposit of select samples (Fig. 5)

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: TITD Metal Material Co., Ltd, Changsha, China
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: irregular shape and more rounded with a large size range
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: abraded with 600 grits SiC abrasive paper and ultrasonically cleaned with absolute ethanol, and was 45° sandblasted by the 100 mesh Al2O3 sands.

experimentalProperties.Process_Gas_Type: compressed air (78 vol% N2, 21 vol% O2 and 1 vol% other gases)
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: before microstructure characterization, an etching solution was 5 g FeCl3, 10 mL HCl and 100 mL H2O was used

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: no obvious difference in the pattern of CuSn5 powder. This demonstrates that the feedstock powders did not have any phase change and particle oxidation inside the composite coatings. dense microstructure with few pores. evidence of severe plastic deformation.

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: TITD Metal Material Co., Ltd, Changsha, China
preSprayedProperties.Secondary_Powder_Source: BGRIMM Advanced Materials Science &Technology Co., Ltd, Beijing, China
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: both powders have irregular shapes, the CuSn5 are more rounded and has a larger size range while the Al2O3 are angular and more uniform in size
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: D10, D50, and D90 values for the Al2O3 are 19.96 μm, 31.94 μm, and 50.56 μm resp.
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: abraded with 600 grits SiC abrasive paper and ultrasonically cleaned with absolute ethanol, and was 45° sandblasted by the 100 mesh Al2O3 sands.

experimentalProperties.Process_Gas_Type: compressed air (78 vol% N2, 21 vol% O2 and 1 vol% other gases)
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: before microstructure characterization, an etching solution was 5 g FeCl3, 10 mL HCl and 100 mL H2O was used

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: no obvious difference in the pattern of CuSn5 powder. This demonstrates that the feedstock powders did not have any phase change and particle oxidation inside the composite coatings. peaks of Al2O3 did not appear in the XRD patterns of the composite coatings primarily owing to the very low Al2O3 contents that deposited in the coatings, this sample was about 1.2 wt% Al2O3 in the coating. intensified plastic deformation due to hammering effect of Al2O3.
